scientific_deviations.definition: A post-freeze change to the registered corpus, mutation, endpoint, baseline, oracle, success criterion, analysis rule, or interpretation boundary.

execution_incidents.definition: An implementation, CI, governance, or evidence-packaging failure encountered while executing or finalizing the frozen protocol, whether or not it could change a scientific result.

items.observation: Initial CI found JSON-spelled Boolean literals in Python and an independence test that inspected its own explanatory docstring.
items.resolution: Corrected the Python literals and restricted the independence assertion to the oracle implementation.

items.observation: The standalone checker could not import the repository-local validation dependency when invoked outside the package context.
items.resolution: Placed the repository root on sys.path before loading the validator.

items.observation: Final audit found stale W4 supporting hashes, an incomplete W6 manifest, and incomplete propagation across canonical governance surfaces.
items.resolution: Rebound the governed evidence, expanded the exact artifact set, and completed canonical propagation.

items.observation: Repository checks treated a Markdown reference to a workflow path as a prohibited executable workflow occurrence.
items.resolution: Reworded the reference so the check continued to reject real transient workflows without rejecting documentation.

items.observation: Finalization used temporary branch-mutating repair and export workflows; the deterministic ocean-remediation attempt failed with a Python SyntaxError before exact workspace and history exports were used.
items.resolution: Removed every temporary workflow from the final tree and added a regression that rejects their return.

items.observation: The W6 workflow initially omitted the repository-mandated job timeout.
items.resolution: Added the mandatory timeout before acceptance.

items.observation: The test-weakening gate detected four renamed regression test identifiers across current-state and W4 coverage.
items.resolution: Restored stable test aliases so historical regression identities remained continuously enforced.
